title: ClearPath Managed IT Services After-Hours Call-Out Minutes
content:
How the minutes of the after-hours remote amount of a ClearPath Managed IT Services ticket are billed follows the after-hours call-out rule, which reads the priority at resolution recorded on the ticket's resolution milestone:

1. A P1 ticket bills the greater of the recorded minutes and 60 minutes, plus 15 minutes.
2. A P2 ticket bills the recorded minutes plus 15 minutes.
3. A P3 or P4 ticket bills the recorded minutes.

The minutes so billed are the minutes divided by 60 to give the hours priced.

**Worked figures (hypothetical).**

| Priority at resolution | Recorded minutes | Minutes billed |
|---|---|---|
| P1 | 30 | the greater of 30 and 60 is 60, plus 15: 75 |
| P1 | 90 | 90 plus 15: 105 |
| P2 | 30 | 45 |
| P3 | 30 | 30 |
| P4 | 45 | 45 |
